exposure: history of insulin administration during pregnancy
awareness regarding screening for Overt Diabetes
outcome: awareness regarding screening for Overt Diabetes
adherence to screening protocols for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus who delivered between January 2022 to December 2022 from a tertiary care hospital in Mandya.
finding: Approximately 26% of GDM women progressed to dysglycemia (Overt Diabetes Mellitus and impaired glucose tolerance) within 2 years post-delivery, with 42% failing to undergo recommended screening primarily due to a lack of awareness and inadequate counseling.
